name: Australia
summary: The Australian Electoral Commission says the next federal election is due between August 2027 and May 2028. No polling day was named in the sources read on 17 October 2026. This release has the national page, eight state and territory pages, 150 House of Representatives divisions, and Victoria’s 88 Legislative Assembly districts and 8 Legislative Council regions, in English. The Victorian Electoral Commission prints a state election on Saturday 28 November 2026.
